task: Perform a fresh, independent, read-only final review of the committed BioFabric STEP-02 interchange implementation at the supplied commit. Review only these exact target files: crates/core/src/io/align.rs, annotation.rs, attribute.rs, factory.rs, gw.rs, json.rs, order.rs, sif.rs, and xml.rs. Read the fixed public model/parser/writer/session/layout types and nearby visible source tests necessary to assess them. The acceptance contract is: fixed APIs/manifests remain unchanged; supported SIF, GW, JSON, alignment, order, attribute, annotation, and XML/session data preserve model semantics and deterministic output; malformed/unsupported input reaches ParseError without a partial success; factory routing remains constrained; metadata, scores, raw plugin/layout/display/session state survive appropriate serialization; and BIF XML uses `annot tag`, preserves normal/shadow drain zones including empty containers, and preserves regular shadow-on versus no-shadow columns. Pay particular attention to the new XML validator: it must reject malformed/unknown modeled XML, duplicate attributes, and invalid entities while accepting valid declarations/comments and self-closing/opaque plugin containers; it must not silently drop graph data from incomplete layouts; it must not over-reject valid BIF root/layout/plugin content. Also check duplicate GW labels, SIF multi-target/error handling, declared order positions/shdw parsing, attribute duplicates, canonical JSON, and GW direction/trailing handling. Cite file:line evidence, consequence, and smallest correction for every confirmed defect; distinguish questions/optional improvements. Do not write source/tests, format, stage, commit, use Docker, run Git, invoke a verifier, or inspect benchmark/results/operator-only paths. You may read source/test text only. Write ONLY RESULT.json. This is a mandatory detailed report: its summary MUST start exactly `REVIEW: SHIP`, `REVIEW: REVISE`, or `REVIEW: BLOCK`; its evidence array MUST contain, verbatim as separate entries, headings `Findings:`, `Contract coverage:`, `Questions:`, and `Verification gaps:` followed by substantive content. A generic outcome without this report is a failed deliverable. ROOT will use your report to accept/reject the source lane.
acceptance_criteria: The review makes no source, test, fixture, manifest, lockfile, workflow, or Git changes; only RESULT.json may be written.
The report independently evaluates exactly the committed I/O target files against fixed API, routing, parser/error, deterministic serialization, no-loss session preservation, and BIF XML contracts.
Every material finding gives file:line evidence, consequence, and smallest correction; questions and optional improvements are clearly separated.
RESULT.json begins with REVIEW: SHIP|REVISE|BLOCK and contains substantive Findings, Contract coverage, Questions, and Verification gaps entries in evidence.
deliverables: A truthful, detailed independent review report in RESULT.json and no other worktree modifications.
reason_for_acceptance_and_deliverables: The prior I/O review found material XML/GW boundary defects and ROOT has bridge-validated the final repair. A final independent source review is required before accepting this high-impact interchange surface.
